From dark I-V characteristics, the values of ideality factor and barrier height of the device were calculated as 1.11 eV and 2.02, respectively. It has been seen that the device exhibited a good photovoltaic behavior with a maximum open circuit voltage of 0.38 V and short-circuit current of 2.8 nA under only 200 lx light intensity.
